placements.title: Calibration
placements.theme: Instrument calibration and verification against reference standards establishes observational readiness.

placements.title: From unverified to reference-verified instrument readiness
placements.theme: Observatory instruments are calibrated to a reference frequency and verified against reference plates across the full observing band before deployment.
placements.why: All four segments carry the same thematic content — the establishment and verification of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz against June reference plates. This is a subject future envelopes will continue to feed as different instruments and calibration cycles are reported, passing the narrative grain test. src-1 and src-2 are Ashgrove's assertive witness; src-3 and src-4 are the session's declarative metadata recording the same instrument and calibration facts. No existing leaf plausibly holds this theme.
